practiceReport.name: Dalton Kincaid
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Standard NFL positional availability baseline (78% Questionable conversion).
factors: Officially ruled Out on weekly game status report
practiceReport.beatComment: Listed as doubtful heading into the weekend after failing to practice in any capacity Wednesday through Friday, Kincaid will wind up missing his first game of the season. Kincaid's 4.5 targets per game will be filtered out among the Bills' other pass-catching options, including Dawson Knox, who will operate as the team's clear No. 1 tight end this week. The Bills will face a quick turnaround for Week 12 with a Thursday matchup versus the Chiefs, so Kincaid may need to practice in some fashion prior to that contest to put himself on a path to play.

practiceReport.name: Ed Oliver
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (DT) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: Oliver popped up on the injury report after informing the team's medical staff of oblique pain and was listed as questionable. However, the veteran is cleared to play for Sunday's divisional meeting with Miami, potentially resulting in fewer snaps for DeWayne Carter, Greg Gaines and Landon Jackson.

practiceReport.name: Amani Hooker
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (8th NFL season, 99% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.
practiceReport.beatComment: Hooker was limited in practice Wednesday and Thursday due to a knee injury, but the veteran safety was a full participant in Friday's session, which was enough for him to avoid an injury tag for Sunday's AFC East showdown. Hooker made his Bills debut against the Jets in Week 10, when he logged seven tackles (four solo) and one pass defense in a 31-12 win for Buffalo.

practiceReport.name: Dee Alford
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (CB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: Alford upgraded his practice participation in each subsequent session of Week 11 prep as he progressed through the five stages of the NFL's concussion protocol. The slot cornerback has been cleared by an independent neurologist and is all set to suit up for Sunday's game.

practiceReport.name: Cole Bishop
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (97% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
practiceReport.beatComment: The safety was limited during Wednesday's session. Bishop has yet to miss a game this season, and it doesn't appear that streak will be snapped Sunday. He has 54 tackles (32 solo), including 1.0 sacks, two pass breakups and a forced fumble in 2026.

practiceReport.name: Ray Davis
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (RB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: The backup running back was managed during the practice week but is good to go for his normal role behind lead back James Cook. With the Bills listed as 16.5-point favorites, Davis could see some extra reps in garbage time if Buffalo does indeed blow out Miami.

practiceReport.name: Damar Hamlin
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Standard NFL positional availability baseline (78% Questionable conversion).
practiceReport.beatComment: Hamlin missed the first two practices of Week 11 prep due to a toe injury, but he earned the questionable tag following Friday's limited session. The sixth-year defensive back was cleared by medical staff to play Sunday following pregame warmups, and he'll provide depth in the secondary behind Amani Hooker and Cole Bishop.

practiceReport.name: Jackson Hawes
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Standard NFL positional availability baseline (78% Questionable conversion).
practiceReport.beatComment: Hawes was in danger of missing this contest due to a shoulder issue, though he will avoid his first absence of the 2026 campaign Sunday versus Miami. With Dalton Kincaid (thumb) sidelined in Week 11, Hawes will have an opportunity to get more involved than usual behind Dawson Knox.

practiceReport.name: Tyrell Shavers
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (WR) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: Shavers was activated from the reserve/PUP list Saturday, and the San Diego State product has been officially cleared to play Sunday in what will be his first game since the Bills AFC wild-card round win over the Jaguars in January, when he tore his ACL. Shavers will likely operate in a rotational role on offense behind DJ Moore, Khalil Shakir and Keon Coleman.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Joshua Palmer
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Placed on Injured Reserve (Undisclosed) ahead of Week 9; must miss at least 4 games (earliest eligible Week 13).

irAndReserveTracker.name: Ar'maj Reed-Adams
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: It's not immediately clear when he suffered the back injury, but Reed-Adams will now have to sit out at least four games as he recovers. His absence leaves veteran Austin Corbett as Buffalo's undisputed backup plan at guard behind starters Alec Anderson and O'Cyrus Torrence.
